current.text: He is 37 and recovering from a torn ACL. He will not be ready for the start of the season.
Christmas is the earliest realistic return. January is the most likely date, and one expert said it could be as late as February.
When he returns, expect a minutes limit and no back-to-back games.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs ending March 28.
Draft him only after round 12 as an IL stash, and only if you have a free IL slot. Drop him once you need that slot. Taking him around round 10 is a bad pick.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year. They are watching their lottery odds and may rest veterans.

durable.text: His game relies on IQ, cutting, physicality and drawing free throws, not on explosiveness.
He makes few threes for a forward. That makes threes his weakest category.
His best categories are FT% on solid volume, assists for a forward, and steals.
He has missed many games in each of the last three seasons.
